Our research spans computational biology, machine learning for genomics, and biosecurity. Below are our main themes — see [Publications](publications.qmd) for the full paper list and [Projects](projects.qmd) for active work.

## Research Themes

### DNA Language Models

Applying large language model architectures to genomic sequences to learn the grammar of DNA.

### Biosecurity

Computational approaches to biosecurity challenges, including sequence screening and risk assessment.

### Open Science & Reproducibility

Building open-source tools and sharing datasets to make computational biology more accessible and reproducible.
